headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 in Mexico City
deck: Estadio Azteca hosts the opening ceremony and first match as 48 nations compete across three countries in the tournament's most ambitious edition yet.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off on June 11, 2026 at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City with an opening ceremony at 11:30 local time, followed by the tournament's first match between Mexico and South Africa. The expanded tournament features 48 teams competing in 104 matches across 16 host cities in Canada, Mexico, and the United States, concluding with the final on July 19, 2026 at New York New Jersey Stadium.
